Insurance & financing made simple

We verify benefits, provide clear estimates, and help you make the most of your coverage.

Insurance friendly

We work with many major PPO plans and process claims on your behalf. Don’t see your plan? Give us a call—we’ll check for you.

  • In‑network with many popular plans
  • Out‑of‑network? We still file claims
  • Pre‑treatment estimates before care

What to bring

Please bring your photo ID and insurance card to your first visit, or email details to {{EMAIL}}.

Transparent pricing & flexible payments

Clear estimates

Know your co‑pay and any out‑of‑pocket costs before we begin. No surprises.

Payment plans

Spread payments over time with in‑house options and third‑party financing for qualified applicants.

Membership plan

No insurance? Join our in‑office membership for preventive care and discounts on treatment.

How billing works

  1. Verify

    We verify your benefits and eligibility prior to your visit whenever possible.

  2. Estimate

    You’ll receive a written estimate outlining insurance portions and your co‑pay.

  3. Submit

    We submit claims electronically and track them to ensure timely processing.

Frequently asked questions

Do you accept my insurance?

We’re in‑network with many major PPO plans, and we’ll gladly verify your benefits. If we’re out‑of‑network, you may still have coverage—call us at {{PHONE}}.

Can I get an estimate before treatment?

Yes. We provide a written estimate after your exam, including your anticipated co‑pay and any remaining balance.

Do you offer financing?

We offer flexible in‑house plans and partner financing for qualified patients. Ask our team for current options.

Questions about coverage?

Our coordinators are here to help.
